Yes—FAB-3 dominated the wafer-stage vacuum-instability delays, accounting for 1,196 of 1,486 minutes across fabrication lines (80%). Across all wafer-fabrication issues, however, FAB-3 caused 1,307 of 2,651 minutes (49%), so it was the largest contributor but not an outright majority.
